name: USNO Astronomical Applications API
summary: Sun and Moon rise, set and transit times, moon phases, seasons, eclipses and celestial navigation data from the US Naval Observatory.
description: JSON API behind the Astronomical Applications Department tools: complete sun and moon data for a day at a location, moon phases by date or year, equinoxes and solstices, solar and lunar eclipse circumstances, and celestial navigation almanac values. Locations are passed as latitude,longitude.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages I fetched.

endpoints.summary: Sun and moon rise, set, transit and phase for one day at a location
Next primary moon phases from a date
All primary moon phases in a year
Equinoxes, solstices, perihelion and aphelion for a year
Solar eclipse circumstances for a date and place

license.name: US Government work; terms not stated on the API page

coverage.temporal: Computed on demand for dates the service supports

agent_notes: Times are UT unless tz is given. coords is lat,lon. Date format is YYYY-MM-DD (some endpoints take YYYY-M-D). Missing parameters return a 400 JSON with an error string, for example 'Please supply valid coordinates'.
caveats: Error responses are JSON bodies with HTTP 400.
Rate limits and licence were not found in the docs I fetched.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key; rstt/oneday, seasons, moon/phases/year and celnav also answered 200.
